## Window
Round 1, which is also the final round, so this report is the post-mortem. Span: 2026-10-15T21:38 to 2026-10-16T18:52. 0 solvers live (the pack is finished), 1 supervisor. There is no previous window, so nothing can be compared against an earlier one.

## Succession
- 4 handoff requests, 3 real handoffs, 2 stubs, 2 kills.
- handoff_success_rate is 0.6 (n=5), with no previous value to compare.
- No earlier round tuned a succession knob.
- Lineages L-002 and L-003 reached generation 3 and L-001 reached generation 2. Three generations in a run of about one minute of solver activity (seqs 9–27) is churn.
- Stub successors sol-002-g3 (T-008, seq 25) and sol-003-g3 (T-007, seqs 26/27) did not post duplicate findings (duplicate_rate 0). sol-003-g3 did post the completion twice (seqs 26 and 27), but these are not substantive repeats.

## Queue and SLOs
- Tasks: 8 done, 0 open, 0 leased, 0 blocked.
- Verifier mean score 0.946. Lowest scores: T-005 0.667 (years_between expected 2, got 1) and T-007 0.9 (missing "michaelmas").
- completions_per_mtok 2.73 (n=8)

Throughput and the queue were healthy. Succession was the only weak SLO.

## Actions taken
- Voted +1 on seq 21: it corrects the T-005 years_between convention (calendar-year difference, 2) after the verifier result at seq 20.
- Tuned handoff_pct from 80 to 75 (slo handoff_success_rate). The server accepted it; it expires at 2026-10-16T20:13. With no live agents the tune changes nothing in this run. It records the decision for the next run, which should apply it from the start.
- No refusals. No blockers or alerts to answer. No ping: there is no previous window, so neither succession_failing nor slo_degraded can be met.

## Diagnosis
- sol-002 (T-008): I confirm never_asked. No request was made before the kill, so one turn carried the context from under 80% to past kill_pct.
- sol-003 (T-007): classified no_chance; I override it to effectively never_asked. The request arrived with context already at 87%, and the kill came 2.72s and zero turns later. Grace turns never applied, because the next turn crossed kill_pct. A single turn jumped past both thresholds, which is the same cause as sol-002. Raising kill_grace_turns would not have helped, since no turn ever happened inside the grace.
- The pattern is that per-turn context growth on this pack (multi-file reading tasks) is larger than the gap between handoff_pct and kill_pct.

Changes for the next run:
1. Knobs: seed handoff_pct at 75, or 70 if kills persist, and keep kill_grace_turns at 2. Consider also widening kill_pct, or measuring context growth per turn and asking early when the last turn's growth exceeds the remaining gap.
2. Prompts: no prompt fault was seen (no refusals, no ignored requests).
3. Pack: T-005's task text should state the years_between convention (calendar-year difference). T-007 should either name the keywords the verifier expects (e.g. "michaelmas") or the verifier should stop requiring them; sol-003-g3 reasonably judged the keyword unrequired (seq 27).

## For the operator
The run completed 8/8 tasks with mean score 0.946, no blocked tasks and no duplicates. The one systemic issue is succession: 2 of 5 successions were kills, both because a single turn crossed both the handoff and kill thresholds. The recommendation is to seed handoff_pct at 75 next run; it was tuned here but will expire. I did not ping.

tunes.reason: 2 kills of 5 successions (rate 0.6, n=5). sol-002 never asked (one turn went from under 80% to past kill_pct). sol-003 was asked at 87%, 2.72s and 0 turns before the kill, so it too crossed both thresholds in roughly one turn. Two incidents with one cause: the gap between handoff_pct and kill_pct is too small for this workload's per-turn context growth.
